name: whatsapp-realtime-chat-app
description: WhatsApp Real-Time Chat Engine with Friend Request verification, SQLite storage, Presence, Ticks, and Dual Simulator

scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='client/dist';const dst='server/public';if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Synced client/dist to server/public');}"
